title.narrative: DFA Year 2 Payment CSF 08-21 For the project 'Furthest

description.narrative: The ‘Furthest Behind First’ project aims to enhance protection of human rights, obtain greater social equity and build resilience and effective mitigation against the impact of Climate Change and other social, environmental and humanitarian disasters of those minority and indigenous peoples in Eastern Africa most at risk of being left behind. The target countries include the Democratic Republic of Congo, Kenya, Rwanda, Tanzania, Uganda and Zimbabwe. The implementing partners are Ogiek Peoples Development Program, Awer Community Conservancy, African Initiative for Mankind Progress Organization, First People Disability Organization, Réseau des Associations Autochtones Pygmées, Foyer de Développement pour l’Autopromotion des Pygmées et Indigènes Défavorisés, Pastoral Women’s Council, Hadzabe Survival Council, Katswe Sisterhood, and Tsoro-o-Tso San Development Trust. The objective is to support the capacity building and public participation of CSOs working with or representing Marginalised and Indigenous Peoples (MIP) communities. The project also plans to push for the achievement of key strategic reforms across the region in order for MIPs to achieve the SDGs. The kay activities include capacity building and access to justice; increased engagement and dialogue with local and national stakeholders, as well as regional and international stakeholders to secure commitments for changes; securing greater public support and solidarity towards MIPs in societies, particularly in relation to climate and environmental actions, as well as Covid-19 recovery; and media capacity building.
